front.text: 听完后，选出这句里造成公交拥挤的原因。
front.task_prompt: 重点听 because：because 后面才是原因，前面通常是结果。

options.text: Two subway lines are under repair this week.
The morning buses are running earlier than usual.
More students are taking the buses after class.
The bus company reduced the ticket price.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分结果描述和 because 后面的原因端信息

audio.transcript: The morning buses are overcrowded because two subway lines are under repair this week.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。The morning buses are overcrowded 是结果，because 后的 two subway lines are under repair this week 才解释了为什么会拥挤。因果题里不要把最先听到的现象当成原因；听到 because 时，要把注意力移到连接词后的解释片段。B、C、D 都没有出现在音频里，也不能解释这句话的因果关系。
tips: because 后面通常回答 why/cause/reason。
先出现的不一定是原因，英语里常先说结果再补原因。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 because 后置原因

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力里追到 because 后的真正原因，避免把表层现象误判为原因。

front.text: 听完后，选出导致 refund policy 被修改的原因。
front.task_prompt: 把 led to 当成箭头：箭头前是原因，箭头后是结果。

options.text: A sharp rise in customer complaints.
The company wanted to simplify internal training.
The refund policy had already been effective.

task_schema.action: 选择因果箭头前的触发因素
task_schema.focus: led to 前后因果方向
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明 complaints 是因，revision of the refund policy 是果

audio.transcript: A sharp rise in customer complaints led to a revision of the refund policy.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。句子主干是 complaints led to revision。lead to / led to 表示“导致”，箭头前的 A sharp rise in customer complaints 是触发因素，箭头后的 revision of the refund policy 是结果。听力因果题常用 policy、plan、system 这类显眼名词干扰你；它们很可能是被改变的对象，而不是真正原因。
tips: 听到 lead to/result in/cause 时，先画清箭头方向。
政策、计划、系统这类名词常在结果端，不能只因显眼就选。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 led to 前后因果方向

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把因果动词短语转成稳定箭头，减少对象词干扰造成的误选。

front.text: 听到 therefore 后，应把哪一项记为结果端？
front.task_prompt: therefore 后面通常给结论或结果，重点抓它后面的动作。

options.text: The lab passed all safety checks.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分 failed safety checks 是原因，launch was postponed 是结果

audio.transcript: The lab failed two safety checks; therefore, the product launch was postponed.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。The lab failed two safety checks 是原因或证据，therefore 后面的 the product launch was postponed 是由此推出的结果。therefore、thus、as a result 这类词常把前面的事实收束成后面的决定或结论；如果题目问结果、决定、后续动作，要优先记 therefore 后的动词短语。B 与原句相反，C 没有依据，D 与 postponed 冲突。
tips: therefore 后常是结论端，重点记后面的谓语动作。
前半句给证据，后半句给决定，是听力中很常见的因果推进。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 therefore 后的结果端

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户听到 therefore 后抓结果和决策动作，避免停留在前半句证据。
